purpose: Stored-payload cases. producer says whether a producer may write the bytes and, if not, which check rejects them: document (UTF-8/JSON/object/duplicate key), schema (asserted by the type's JSON Schema), semantic (annotated in the schema, enforced by the receiver), legacy (opened by the receiver, never written by a producer), normalization (a blank optional the receiver ignores, which a producer omits). stored says how the receiver treats the bytes: typed (opens as its type: decode_typed_value and validate_typed_value both pass), opaque (kept as an opaque value, e.g. a legacy generic that is not UTF-8), reject (not a valid stored value of its type). rust_decode and rust_producer_validation are the verdicts of the real Rust functions.
